fixed_specificity_controls: Each exact number of asserted fields uses identical decisions across penalty ratios; repeated rows are controls.
full_analysis: FULL_ANALYSIS.json.gz retains all world means, every reader/rival contrast and every ratio. This compact file keeps all reader means and shifts, all maker comparisons and the naive duplicate-removal control.
interval: 4096 whole-world paired bootstrap draws, descriptive 95% interval; no multiplicity adjustment
known_root_policy: At zero artificial copying known-root probabilities equal latent-full and add no distinct forecast.
limitations: Selected reused development forecasts, not new independent evidence or confirmation.
Same supplied current support as upstream readers; no copied-cell ceilings or refitted convergence.
Fresh-law direct receives additional labels and is a separate diagnostic.
Fixed cardinality matches number of fields, not identities of fields; adaptive policies change case coverage.
Intervals are descriptive across many contrasts; no promotion criterion registered here.
Validation selects the episode power over all three registered duplication rates. Selection is not retuned on these development worlds.
loss: Fraction of seven fields withheld plus false-specificity penalty times any wrong asserted field.
